findings.reason: Evidence confirms the event and spikes, but does not prove the crowd caused the spikes or that S-TUN-002/003 are near the venue.
T1 and T6 explicitly list spikes in traffic, active users, and PRB utilization for all three sites.
EVT-003 explicitly states the football match at Stade Olympique de Rades from 19:11 to 22:11.
T8 output reports no changes on the specified sites and ancestors during the window.
T9 output reports no maintenance windows on the specified sites and ancestors during the window.
T3, T4, and T7 all describe the respective sites as being 'near a venue'.
